description: Voies ferrées d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [Situation 2007] Ce jeu de données représente le réseau ferré d'Île-de-France (SNCF et RER). Il contient les informations de base: type de la ligne (RER, transilien, grande ligne, TGV, autre). Consulter la métadonnée. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Aménagement du territoire. Its keywords are RER, Transilien, Grande ligne, TGV. The portal shows 41 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
